# DataGridExport

`Flare.Components.DataGridExport`

Toolbar buttons that export the grid's filtered and sorted rows, one per exporter, or a split button with the first exporter as its main action.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DataProvider` | `Func<Task<DataGridExportData<TItem>>>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Advanced override: supply the export data directly instead of reading it from the bound grid. When set it takes precedence. |
| `Exporters` | `IReadOnlyList<IDataGridExporter<TItem>>?` | `` | Parameter |  | List of pluggable exporters rendered as toolbar buttons. |
| `FileName` | `string` | `"export"` | Parameter |  | File name used when exporting data (without extension). |
| `OnExported` | `EventCallback<string>` | `` | Callback |  | Callback raised when an export is completed. The parameter is the exporter ID. |
| `Split` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | When true (and there is more than one exporter), renders a split button: the first exporter is the primary action and the remaining exporters open in the dropdown menu. When false (the default) every exporter is rendered as its own button. |
| `AdditionalAttributes` | `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Additional attributes. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
| `Class` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Additional CSS class(es) appended to the component's root element. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
| `Context` | `DataGridContext<TItem>?` | `` | Parameter |  | The grid context this control drives. Set it to place the control anywhere on the page; omit it inside a grid, where the cascade supplies one. Inherited from `FlareDataGridControl`. |
| `Grid` | `FlareDataGrid<TItem>?` | `` | Parameter |  | The grid this control drives, as an alternative to Context when the page already holds an @ref to the grid itself. Inherited from `FlareDataGridControl`. |
| `Style` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Inline style string appended to the component's root element. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
